Definition: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
BiblicalUsage: 1) tooth, ivory; 1a) tooth; 1a1) of man, lex talionis, beast; 1b) tooth, tine (of fork); 1c) ivory; 1c1) as material; 1c2) of commerce; 1d) sharp pointed rock
